Sprint 29 — Board 02: the benchmark picker and the crash benchmark (#1416, ADR-0046 amendment 2026-11-07, ADR-0058 §1)

Decided: every read that takes benchmark=security:<id> accepts any security with at least one stored quote, flagged or not; is_benchmark keeps its meaning (reference-only: not bookable, out of the data-quality sets) and is the picker's default content; the picker offers the flagged securities first and the held ones after them, and is built only after its board (ADR-0046, amendment of 2026-11-07, point 3; #1416). The crash benchmark is one instance setting, set through the API, its MCP tool and the screen, journaled, with no default; the Crashes section's „no benchmark“ line links to it (ADR-0058 §1).

Today the screen has two pickers, both flagged-only (Catalog.list_securities(is_benchmark: true)): Bestände's „Benchmark…“ disclosure (portfolio_live.ex) and „Nach dem Verkauf“'s select, on Cashflow and on a security's Trades tab (sale_hindsight_section.ex). Predictions take their benchmark over the API only. Both screens also resolve a chosen id against the flag (resolve_benchmark_security/1 in portfolio_live.ex, the flagged list in sale_hindsight_section.ex), so a held security ticked in the new picker would fall back to „not selected“ unless the story changes those resolvers with the picker. No settings page exists; the one instance setting with a screen, the default view, is set where it acts (the view switcher).

Proposed here: Q1 both pickers show two labelled groups, „Benchmarks“ then „Im Bestand“ (held today in any depot, with a stored quote, by name), no search (A); Q2 the crash benchmark is chosen inline, in the Crashes section's window disclosure, with the same two groups (A). Dashed outline: new.

① Bestände: „Benchmark…“ today and as proposed recommended

Today: the flagged securities only. A (recommended, Q1): two groups, each label in one column and its options from one edge (DESIGN.md, „Labelled controls start on one edge“): the flagged ones first, then every security held today with a stored quote, by name. A held security used as the benchmark stays bookable and stays in every check, because it is not flagged. A held security without a stored quote is not offered: the API would refuse it with 422.

② Variant B: plus a search over every security with quotes

B: A and a search for any catalogue security with stored quotes, held or not, which the API accepts since the amendment. Not recommended: the amendment names flagged and held; an unheld reference series is what the flag is for (flag it on Wertpapiere and it appears under „Benchmarks“), and a search turns a short choice into the catalogue. Flip: „Benchmark-Suche“.

③ „Nach dem Verkauf“: the select today and as proposed recommended

The same two groups as <optgroup>s of the native select (drawn open beside it, as a browser shows it). Its default stays the first flagged security, as today.

④ Where the crash benchmark is chosen: inline (A) or a settings page (B) recommended

A (recommended, Q2): in the Crashes section. Unset, the data note's „Crash-Benchmark wählen“ opens the windows disclosure with the form; set, the rule line's „Ändern“ opens it. The select carries the same two groups; „Speichern“ writes the setting through the API's path, journaled under the operator. The hints say what the setting means for agents and what happens to names (§3). B: a new page „Einstellungen“ under Verwaltung, where later instance settings could gather (the news clustering's two values are API-only today). Not recommended now: one setting does not make a page, the operator meets the question where the crashes are, and the default view set in place is the precedent. Flip: „Einstellungsseite“.

⑤ B2 — die Gruppe „Weitere“ (added by the build)

Found while building Q1 A, drawn before the sprint PR lands: a link may name a quoted security that is neither flagged nor held (the API accepts it since the amendment; an agent's link may carry one). The built pickers compare it, and show it in a third group, „Weitere“, after „Benchmarks“ and „Im Bestand“, so the picker never shows one security while comparing another, and applying the form again keeps it (PortfolixirWeb.BenchmarkChoices.with_chosen/2). The group is there only while such a security is chosen: untick it and apply, or pick another in the select, and it is gone; it is never a way to find one (variant B's search stays off). Drawn as the build renders it, with the shipped app.css: the label column at 1200 px, the label above its options on a phone (≤ 560 px). The select's open list is drawn beside it, as in ③. Dashed: the new group. Flip: „Ohne Gruppe Weitere“ — the picker then drops a security it does not offer, as before.
